problem: Portal metrics existed in separate finance, people, productivity, commercial and roadmap surfaces but did not form one causal management-accounting/value graph that translated benchmark gaps into value and effort.
decision: Introduce one derived, fail-closed value-driver intelligence projection over existing canonical tenant state rather than a parallel KPI store.
rules: Use output per hour when actual hours are available; keep per-FTE metrics as complementary.
Missing data stays missing; benchmarks are only explicit stored evidence.
Create roadmap candidates only from evidenced adverse benchmark gaps.
Valuation scenarios require explicit supported multiples and remain estimates.
